decisions.reason: The accent's existing requirement to derive from the Hero V geometry already incorporates later refinements to that geometry; the source does not independently change the accent's derivation rule, role, or consistency dimensions.
The existing derivation rule already requires the closing V to follow the Hero V geometry. Selecting and refining the Hero V arms does not independently modify the closing V requirement.
The source concerns only the Hero V arm relationship and does not resume or alter the deferred E and L letterform requirement.
The source refines black-and-white Hero V geometry and does not change the deferred champagne material treatment or its long-term role.
The selected Hero V arm geometry does not change or resume the deferred full-wordmark kerning requirement.
The source does not change the closing V's smaller, subordinate prominence relative to the Hero V.
The source contains design feedback about Hero V geometry and has no effect on acceptable proof attachment formats.
